name: Kuku
source:
A Great Old One hailing from the underwater city of R'lyeh. 

Aiming to revive her dedicated following of worshippers after her cult has dwindled down to almost nothing, she enlists the help of [url=/c130409]You Yashima[/url] to make her into the most popular and adorable idol ever known.
translation:
A Great Old One hailing from the underwater city of R'lyeh. 

Aiming to revive her dedicated following of worshippers after her cult has dwindled down to almost nothing, she enlists the help of [url=/c130409]You Yashima[/url] to make her into the most popular and adorable idol ever known.
